items.summary: A U.S. Marine died Tuesday “following a training incident” in Okinawa, Japan, the service announced.

items.title: Navy appoints Rucker as new PAE Maritime lead
items.summary: Rear Adm. Jonathan Rucker is the second person to hold the position since PAE Maritime was established in March.
